scientific limitations/integrity: The new theorem concerns only central cuts of odd regular polygons. The maximal halfspace-depth value itself was published by Rousseeuw--Ruts and is explicitly not claimed as new; the new content is the exact angular profile, an analytic proof of edge-parallel optimality, and uniqueness modulo dihedral symmetry. The proof is symbolic; finite clipping checks are only consistency tests. Targeted searches found no later source stating the same profile or uniqueness, but an unindexed or differently phrased proof remains a residual originality risk.
title: Strict central-cut profile for regular odd polygons
